name: Kevin Augusto Vieira
summary: Senior Product Owner with 8+ years of professional experience leading product backlogs, user story refinement, and Agile ceremonies (Scrum/Kanban) across digital products and technology platforms. Expert in translating business goals into crisp user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specs for Engineering and QA teams. Fluent in English for daily international communication, featuring a logical background in Engineering & Philosophy (UFPR/UTFPR) and proven autonomy in distributed squads. Based in Curitiba, Brazil with full availability for occasional in-person meetings.

bullets: Product Backlog Management & Agile Ceremonies (Meta): Managed and prioritized adoption feature backlogs for Meta CRM. Facilitated refinement ceremonies, wrote user stories, and defined acceptance criteria with Engineering and QA, accelerating user ramp-up by 50%.

Stakeholder Alignment & Requirement Clarification: Served as daily primary contact for clarifying business requirements and removing blockers, reporting progress and adoption metrics (+150%) to international leadership.
Governance & Progress Analytics: Monitored operational progress and Power BI analytics to maintain alignment between product roadmap and sprint delivery.

0-to-1 Product Backlog Ownership: Led the product backlog for the 'Meu Barzin Pass' MVP, writing user stories, mapping API integration requirements (WhatsApp/Stripe), and refining business logic with technical teams.
Acceptance Criteria & Quality: Conducted root-cause analysis on API latency bottlenecks (43.9% drop-off), refining acceptance criteria and prioritizing technical debt remediation.
Product Specifications (40+ Projects): Managed development backlogs for 40+ digital solutions, aligning client requirements with dev teams through user stories and sprint backlog prioritization.
Acceptance Testing & CRO: Conducted user acceptance testing (UAT) and interface optimizations that increased qualified lead conversions by +250%.
Educational SaaS Backlog Management: Managed user stories and backlog for an LMS platform launch, securing 50 sales in the first 2 months.
Requirement Mapping & User Journeys: Structured 10-stage user journey requirements for engagement and retention.
